## Stack

React.js, Next.js, Node.js, Nest.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Docker, Strapi,
MongoDB, MySQL, AWS, Claude Code.

Also worked with: .NET, Azure Pipelines, Firebase, payment gateway
integrations, continuous integration, technical SEO.

## Experience

### Software Developer at Vangwe — December 2019 to present

Part of the team on Amber, a Uruguayan investment platform, and on Guesty, an
Israeli property management system with thousands of employees around the
world. Also built Fatsack, a mobile application, along with e-commerce sites
and management platforms. Implemented integrations with payment gateways and
services such as AWS, Firebase and social media platforms, working alongside
design and development teams on multinational products.

Domains: fintech, proptech, mobile, e-commerce, payment gateways.

### Software Developer at Sicfe S.A — from August 2022

Contributed to an electronic invoicing system for Paraguay, built on the .NET
ecosystem. Full stack role that included setting up continuous integration with
Azure Pipelines and working directly with clients to resolve questions and
issues.

Domains: electronic invoicing, .NET, CI/CD.
